_readme: USD per 1M tokens. A row matches any model id that contains its key (longest key wins). A row with a null price is reported as tokens only. The Claude rows are Anthropic list prices (as of 2026-09); Bedrock sets its own prices, so replace them with your region's rates from https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/. Fill the Codex rows from your provider's price sheet.
